_readme: TitanEngine Android toolchain locations. Copy this file to cache/config/android-toolchain.json and fill in the paths on your machine.
Nothing is downloaded or guessed: an empty entry is reported as an error, and a wrong path is reported verbatim.

Relative paths (including -ConfigPath) are resolved against the repository root, never against the caller's current directory. Environment variables such as %LOCALAPPDATA% are NOT expanded - write full absolute paths.
Check your setup with: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File BuildScript\check\check-android-toolchain.ps1 -Stage Native  (exit 0 = ready, exit 2 = something is missing)
Stages build on each other: Native (build libCore.Android.so) needs ndk + cmake + ninja; Managed (managed layer and APK) adds dotnet + androidSdk + javaHome; Device adds adb on top of Managed.
Override the config location with -ConfigPath or the TITAN_ANDROID_TOOLCHAIN_CONFIG environment variable.
